scope: recovered historical development candidate review; not human gold, independent holdout, or measured quality gain
review: AI read 18 positive/contextual before/after records and change windows for 32 other candidates; labels remain provisional, no human review or later-revert verification. Findings refer to the shown changed spans, not the articles' factual accuracy. Source passage text is not redistributed.
source_attribution: Turkish Wikipedia contributors; source diff IDs and article histories in wiki-historical-pilot-v1.json and private artifact; Wikimedia Terms of Use https://foundation.wikimedia.org/wiki/Policy:Terms_of_Use

findings.decision: Local spelling/spacing correction; does not certify the rest of the passage. Independent AI inspection, not editor verification.
The changed span addresses a spelling or spacing issue, but other visible defects remain; do not treat the after revision as gold or copy its residual errors.
Context-dependent wording, terminology, parallelism or register change; no blanket synonym replacement, and no automatic improvement merely because the revision is later.
Temporal stance, deleted recommendation, expanded action, added factual statement or changed scope: content changes are not licensed by a language-only brief.
Questionable direction/partial fix; check current normative spelling and punctuation function, not revision order.
Noise insertion/removal: useful negative cases for data selection, not evidence of native blog editorial quality.
